description:
If the little things set you off, the big things will break you.

Success requires capacity.
Capacity to handle pressure.
Capacity to solve harder problems.
Capacity to stay focused when things don’t go your way.

The people who win aren’t the ones with fewer problems…
They’re the ones who built the strength to handle bigger ones.

If you want the next level of success, stop asking for it to be easier.

Start training yourself to be stronger.
transcript: pass somebody in a car and maybe I swerve a little bit and they flip me off or they yell, I think to myself, ah, poor thing. They don't have bigger problems to solve. If I order a medium rare steak and they bring me well done chicken, I just eat it. I got bigger things to worry about. Took a little while to train them, but once I did, life was never the same.
